SPEC COMPLIANCE CHUNK SOF-VD-03: SQL-on-FHIR ViewDefinition — Key Elements: Select, ViewDefinition.select, ViewDefinition.select.column, ViewDefinition.select.column.path/name/description. Test these items: select 1..* required and non-empty, column 0..* within each select, column.path 1..1 FHIRPath expression relative to the active context, column.name 1..1 SQL-safe output name, column.description 0..1 markdown retention, multiple select blocks and deterministic column ordering, root and select-relative FHIRPath evaluation contexts. For DuckDB-backed FHIRPath/CQL surfaces, test both the native/C++ extension path and the Python fallback where both exist, and compare outputs between paths. For SQL-on-FHIR ViewDefinition chunks, test parser validation, SQL generation, DuckDB execution, and official spec fixtures/examples relevant to the chunk.

When the pipeline is fully complete, set workflow to null, set exit_reason, write all handoff files, and return control to the outer spec compliance orchestrator.

issues.spec_citation: SQL-on-FHIR ViewDefinition.select.column.description is 0..1 markdown (https://sql-on-fhir.org/ig/2.0.0/StructureDefinition-ViewDefinition-definitions.html#ViewDefinition.select.column.description); FHIR JSON primitive elements must be represented as string/number/boolean values when present and absent otherwise (https://fhir.hl7.org/fhir/json.html#primitive).
issues.evidence: Fresh SOF-VD-03 EXPLORER probe: parse_view_definition accepted {"description": null} on a column and materialized Column.description=None. Expected parser rejection because present column.description is a markdown primitive, not JSON null.
issues.root_cause: _parse_column used col_data.get("description"), so a present JSON null was indistinguishable from an absent optional field before validate_column_fields/validate_optional_markdown.
issues.resolution: Parser/public-constructor input now rejects present JSON null for select.column.description while preserving direct dataclass None-as-absent behavior.
issues.verified_in: Architect reviewed fresh probe PASS; parser unit 180/180; focused integration 6/6; official spec slice 138/138; ViewDefinition pytest 941/941; ViewDefinition conformance 134/134; full conformance 2822/2822.
